fusions.name: Cast Mesh
fusions.desc: Hurls a weighted mesh that deals 14 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drawstring
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangle Fence
fusions.desc: Strings a 6-tile net across a point ahead for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Slack
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
